name: Nonomiya Kaori
source:
First year student and library committee member. She's normally pretty quiet but one who dares to disrupt the peace in the library shall face divine punishment by the maiden's tome*. Hell hath no fury like a librarian scorned.

Liked foods: omelet 
Disliked foods: things that look like they are still alive
Favorite subjects: modern Japanese, classical literature, Chinese classics
Disliked subjects: math, physics, chemistry, health and physical education

*Actually a thick copy of [i]Home Medicine[/i].
